_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored.
Queries are deliberately few and specific: a listener with twenty vague
queries produces a digest nobody reads, which is the same as no listener.

reddit._note: Works far better with REDDIT_CLIENT_ID / REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET set; see lib/sources/reddit.mjs. Without them it uses search RSS, which Reddit rate-limits hard from a datacenter IP.

rss._note: Google Alerts will give you an RSS feed for any query. Create one at google.com/alerts, set Deliver to = RSS feed, and paste the URL here. This is how you cover X, LinkedIn and the long tail without scraping anything.
